gaps.sentence: He ___ all knowledge of the missing file.
gaps.explanation: 'Deny all knowledge of something' is the fixed phrase.

gaps.sentence: The new regulations came into ___ last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Come into effect' means to start being used; 'affect' is a verb and cannot follow 'into'.

gaps.sentence: The committee will ___ your application at its May meeting.
gaps.explanation: The finite verb slot needs 'consider'; 'considerable' means large.

gaps.hint: the uncountable activity of travelling in general
gaps.explanation: 'Travel' is uncountable when it means travelling in general; the other options are countable nouns.

gaps.sentence: The money was divided ___ the four children.
gaps.hint: for a group of more than two
gaps.explanation: 'Among' is traditionally used for more than two; 'between' is preferred for exactly two.

gaps.sentence: Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: Pens, envelopes and paper are sold in the ___ department.
gaps.explanation: 'Stationery' means writing materials; 'stationary' is an adjective meaning not moving.

gaps.sentence: The gallery is open daily ___ Mondays, when it closes for cleaning.
gaps.explanation: 'Except' excludes; 'accept' is the verb for receiving willingly.
